import cv2,numpy as np,json,sys
out=[]
for p in json.load(sys.stdin):
    image=cv2.imdecode(np.fromfile(p,dtype=np.uint8),cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    text,points,_=cv2.QRCodeDetector().detectAndDecode(image)
    out.append({'path':p,'decoded_text':text,'passed':points is not None and text=='known'})
print(json.dumps({'opencv':cv2.__version__,'cases':out},ensure_ascii=False))
